title: Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant and System Operators
description: Operate or control an entire process or system of machines, often through the use of control boards, to transfer or treat water or wastewater.

projection.title: Water and wastewater treatment plant and system operators

tasks.text: Collect and test water and sewage samples, using test equipment and color analysis standards.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical/physical testing requires lab manipulation

dwas.name: Test chemical or physical characteristics of materials or products.
Collect samples of materials or products for testing.

tasks.text: Operate and adjust controls on equipment to purify and clarify water, process or dispose of sewage, and generate power.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical and water systems controlled physically on site

dwas.name: Operate chemical processing or water treatment systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Record operational data, personnel attendance, or meter and gauge readings on specified forms.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Add chemicals, such as ammonia, chlorine, or lime, to disinfect and deodorize water and other liquids.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Chemical and water systems controlled physically on site

dwas.name: Operate chemical processing or water treatment systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect equipment or monitor operating conditions, meters, and gauges to determine load requirements and detect malfunctions.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

tasks.text: Direct and coordinate plant workers engaged in routine operations and maintenance activities.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

tasks.text: Clean and maintain tanks, filter beds, and other work areas, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

tasks.text: Maintain, repair, and lubricate equipment, using hand tools and power tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

emerging_tasks.task: Complete wastewater discharge monitoring reports and maintenance logs.
Maintain and repair portable safety equipment and permanent safety infrastructure to ensure operational readiness and compliance with safety protocols.
